long_biography.plain_text:
Dmitri Bukhman first explored programming on a computer his grandfather gave the family. While Igor was at university and Dmitri was still at school, the brothers built and sold simple PC games online. They founded Playrix in 2004, developed a distributed studio model and moved from downloadable titles into mobile gaming. The company remained privately funded by its own operations, with the brothers retaining majority ownership.

The success of Playrix gave the family a platform for investment and philanthropy. Rix Capital now manages a diversified, long-term portfolio for the Bukhman family. With his wife, Daria, he also founded Bukhman Philanthropies, supporting maternal and neonatal care, young people's mental health and wellbeing, and literature. The work extends a career begun through code into institutions intended to outlast individual games.
